claim: Electronic storage fully replaces rotating media
originalWording: Electronic storage fully replaces rotating media

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Rotating magnetic and optical computer storage is fully replaced by electronic storage.
reference.rationale: Hard drives remained substantial in 2019; solid-state adoption did not amount to full replacement. Seagate’s 2026 32 TB drive rollout provides a direct current counterexample. “Fully replaced” is genuinely stronger than “widely available.”
